primary_sources.name: HTTP Dataset CSIC 2010
primary_sources.publisher: Information Security Institute (ISI), Consejo Superior de Investigaciones Científicas (CSIC - Spanish National Research Council), Madrid, Spain
primary_sources.traffic_characterization: Automated synthetic testbed traffic generated against experimental e-commerce application 'tienda1' using web crawlers and automated web vulnerability scanners (Paros proxy, Nessus); NOT captured real-world production network traffic from live human attackers
primary_sources.license_status: Unresolved / Custom Academic Research Intent (No formal OSI or Creative Commons license published)
primary_sources.license_terms_analysis: The authors published the dataset for research into web anomaly detection. However, no formal license declaration (such as MIT, Apache-2.0, or CC-BY) was provided on the original host pages. Third-party portals (such as Kaggle or UNB) label it informally as 'Public' or 'Academic', but these represent repository categorizations rather than an explicit legal grant from CSIC. Local research execution is standard academic fair use, but commercial redistribution rights remain unresolved.

permissions.local_research_evaluation_status: Authorized under academic fair use and authors' published intent
permissions.commercial_redistribution_status: Unresolved and legally ambiguous; no explicit commercial distribution or sublicensing grant exists
permissions.recommendation: Obtain explicit written authorization from CSIC or replace with an open-licensed dataset (e.g. Apache-2.0 / CC-BY-4.0) prior to commercial distribution or product bundling.

primary_sources.name: OWASP ModSecurity Core Rule Set (CRS) Regression Test Cases
primary_sources.publisher: OWASP Foundation / OWASP Core Rule Set Project
primary_sources.traffic_characterization: Synthetic security regression test payloads executed via go-ftw / ftw frameworks to validate WAF detection rules
primary_sources.scope_limitation: The Apache-2.0 license applies EXCLUSIVELY to the 16 attack payloads derived from OWASP CRS rules. It does NOT extend to CSIC 2010 records or project-created scenarios.

primary_sources.name: Project-Created Benign Baseline Controls (REST API & Modern Web)
primary_sources.creator: AI-Enabled Adaptive Cyber Deception Gateway Project
primary_sources.purpose: Provides realistic benign REST API queries (/api/v1/products, /api/v1/health) and static web pages alongside 2010 JSP routes to evaluate feature extractors against modern HTTP patterns.
